scope: Phase 1 is artifact-only; no aggregate gate (lint/test/check-types/build) is run. This file classifies known pre-existing failures for Phase 4 reconciliation.

pre_existing_failures.description: Mixed Jest/Vitest test runners across apps (being normalized)
294 legacy API routes across reading-advantage, primary-advantage, science-advantage not yet using domain functions
254 porcelain entries (modified + untracked) at Phase 1 capture; packages/types has 3 dirty entries affecting any scoped check-types baseline
pre_existing_failures.impact_on_baseline: Scoped TS 5.9 check-types on packages/types reflects dirty worktree state, not committed state. Recorded as contaminated in compiler-baseline.json.

reconciliation_rule: Phase 4 runs TURBO_CONCURRENCY=1 pnpm turbo run lint|test|check-types|build and reconciles each failure against this classification. A failure present here is 'pre-existing' (allowed). A failure NOT present here but present in Phase 4 is 'migration-caused' (stop-loss).
